chunks: Muḥammad ibn al-Qāsim al-Astarābādī narrated to me from Yūsuf ibn Muḥammad ibn Ziyād and ʿAlī ibn Muḥammad ibn Yasār, from their fathers, from al-Ḥasan ibn ʿAlī ibn Muḥammad ibn ʿAlī ibn Mūsā ibn Jaʿfar ibn Muḥammad ibn ʿAlī ibn al-Ḥusayn ibn ʿAlī ibn Abī Ṭālib, from his father, from his forefathers, from Amīr al-Muʾminīn عليه السلام, who said:

The Messenger of Allah صلى الله عليه وآله said: “When Allah, Mighty and Majestic, sent Mūsā ibn ʿImrān and chose him as one spoken to intimately, parted the sea for him, saved the Children of Israel, and gave him the Tawrah and the Tablets, he saw his rank before his Lord, Mighty and Majestic, and said: ‘My Lord, You have honored me with an honor by which You have not honored anyone before me.’

Allah, Majestic is His Glory, said: ‘O Mūsā, do you not know that Muḥammad صلى الله عليه وآله is more virtuous in My sight than all My angels and all My creation?’ Mūsā said: ‘My Lord, if Muḥammad is more honored in Your sight than all Your creation, then is there among the families of the Prophets anyone more honored than my family?’

Allah, Mighty and Majestic, said: ‘O Mūsā, do you not know that the excellence of the family of Muḥammad over all the families of the Prophets is like the excellence of Muḥammad over all the messengers?’ He said: ‘My Lord, if the family of Muḥammad is like that, then is there among the communities of the Prophets any community more virtuous in Your sight than my community?’
You shaded them ‘with the clouds,’ and sent down upon them ‘the manna and the quails,’ and parted the sea for them.
Allah, Mighty and Majestic, said: ‘O Mūsā, do you not know that the excellence of the Ummah of Muḥammad over all communities is like his excellence over all My creation?’

Mūsā عليه السلام said: ‘My Lord, I wish that I could see them.’ Then Allah, Mighty and Majestic, revealed to him: ‘O Mūsā, you will never see them, for this is not the time of their appearance. But you shall see them in the gardens, the Gardens of ʿAdn and al-Firdaws, in the presence of Muḥammad, turning about in their bliss and delighting in their good things. Would you like Me to let you hear their speech?’

He said: ‘Yes, my God.’ Allah, Mighty and Majestic, said: ‘Stand before Me and tighten your waist-wrapper, standing as a lowly servant stands before the majestic King.’ So Mūsā عليه السلام did that, and our Lord, Mighty and Majestic, called out: ‘O Ummah of Muḥammad!’ and they all answered Him.

While they were in the loins of their fathers and the wombs of their mothers: ‘Labbayka Allāhumma labbayk, labbayka lā sharīka laka labbayk, inna al-ḥamda wa al-niʿmata laka wa al-mulk, lā sharīka laka labbayk.’
He said: So Allah, Mighty and Majestic, made that response the شعار of hajj.” The hadith is lengthy; we have taken from it the place of need, and I have already cited it in the Tafsir of the Qur'an.

key_terms.آلِ مُحَمَّدٍ: the family of Muḥammad, possessing special divine distinction
key_terms.جَنَّاتِ عَدْنٍ: the Gardens of Eden in Paradise
key_terms.لَبَّيْكَ: a response of readiness and devotion to Allah
key_terms.نَجِيًّا: one taken into intimate divine discourse

ai.seo_question: How does this hadith explain the origin of the talbiyah of hajj and the virtue of the Ummah of Muḥammad?
ai.summary: This hadith describes a dialogue in which Allah informs Mūsā عليه السلام of the superior rank of Muḥammad صلى الله عليه وآله, his Ahl al-Bayt, and his Ummah. It also links the talbiyah of hajj to a primordial response of the Ummah of Muḥammad, and mentions their future presence in the gardens of Paradise with the Prophet صلى الله عليه وآله.
